Quick Point Nature Preserve.verification: Commons title and description 'Quick Point Nature Preserve in Longboat Key, Florida' by Ryan Hodnett, 2023-01-24, geotag 27.336745,-82.582433 falls inside the preserve at the island's south end; part of the photographer's same-day Quick Point series. Seen: sheltered mangrove-fringed tidal lagoon matching the town's description of the restored lagoon. No people. Live Commons licence checked: CC BY-SA 4.0.
